title: Siemens to expand portfolio for semiconductor design and verification with the planned acquisition of Lauterbach

status.text: Siemens agreed on 10 Nov 2026 to acquire German debug-tool maker Lauterbach; the deal, expected to close in H1 2027, adds hardware debug and trace tools to Siemens' chip design and verification portfolio.
status.text_ja: シーメンスは2026年11月10日、独ローターバッハの買収で合意。チップ設計・検証向けデバッグ技術の拡充が目的で、完了は2027年上半期の見込み。

background.headline: Siemens agrees to buy Defacto Technologies to add automated SoC design tools
background.summary: Siemens signed an agreement to acquire Defacto Technologies, a privately held French EDA company active in RTL design and automated SoC design creation and integration; financial terms were not disclosed.
background.summary_ja: シーメンスは仏EDA企業デファクト・テクノロジーズの買収で合意した。RTL設計やSoCの自動設計・統合技術を手がける非公開企業で、買収金額は非公開。

background.headline: Siemens agrees to buy Precision Innovations for AI-driven chip-planning tools
background.summary: Siemens signed an agreement to acquire Precision Innovations, a San Diego-based EDA company whose software is built on the open-source OpenROAD framework, to expand AI-powered chip-planning and design-exploration tools; terms were not disclosed.
background.summary_ja: シーメンスは米EDA企業プレシジョン・イノベーションズの買収で合意した。オープンソースOpenROADを基盤とするAI活用のチップ計画・設計検討ツールを取得する狙いで、条件は非公開。

background.headline: Siemens buys AI metrology firm Canopus AI for its Calibre EDA portfolio
background.summary: Siemens Digital Industries Software acquired Canopus AI, a Grenoble-based company whose AI software analyzes wafer and mask metrology and inspection data, adding computational metrology to Siemens' Calibre EDA portfolio; the price was not disclosed.
background.summary_ja: シーメンス・デジタル・インダストリーズ・ソフトウェアは仏グルノーブルのカノーパスAIを買収した。ウエハー・マスクのメトロロジー・検査向けAI技術をCalibre EDA製品群に取り込む狙いで、価格は非公開。

since.headline: Siemens targets first-half 2027 close for Lauterbach deal, founder to stay on
since.summary: Siemens said the planned Lauterbach acquisition is expected to close in the first half of 2027 subject to customary approvals; Lauterbach generated about EUR60 million in revenue in 2025 and serves over 1,200 clients, and co-founder Stephan Lauterbach and executive Thomas Ullmann are set to remain with the company.
since.summary_ja: シーメンスは、計画中のローターバッハ買収は通常の承認を前提に2027年上半期の完了を見込むとした。ローターバッハの2025年売上高は約6000万ユーロ、顧客は1200社超で、共同創業者シュテファン・ローターバッハ氏と幹部トーマス・ウルマン氏は買収後も残留する。
